4 افرزهُ : see 1, in six places. ―
-b2- أَفْرَزْتُ فُلاَنًا بِشَىْءٍ I made such a one to have a thing to himself alone, with none to share, or participate, with him in it. (A.) ＝
-A2- Also It (an object of the chase) offered him an opportunity (S, O, K) so that he shot it, or shot at it, (S, O,) from within a short distance. (S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
